instruction: For privacy reasons, I don't want notifications to appear on the lock screen. Please disable lock screen notifications.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires disabling notifications on the lock screen for privacy. The config enables show-in-lock-screen (true), and the agent must disable it (false). Similar complexity to the original task but targets a different notification privacy setting.
metadata.verification: Verified that gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.notifications show-in-lock-screen returns 'true\n' or 'false\n'. This is a standard GNOME notification privacy setting.
